newsitem.title: CHINA: China welcomes President Clinton's move on MFN.
newsitem.headline: China welcomes President Clinton's move on MFN.

text.p: Beijing said on Tuesday it welcomed a move by U.S. President Bill Clinton to renew China's favoured trading status as a wise decision.
But a Foreign Ministry spokesman urged Washington to grant the trade concessions on a permanent basis.
"We welcome President Clinton's announcement to extend Most Favoured Nation (MFN) trading status for China," the spokesman told a regular news briefing.
"We think that this decision by President Clinton is a wise deicsion," he said.

However, the annual review of MFN trading status for China was not conducive to the normal and stable development of trade relations, he said and called on Washington to grant the status on a permanent basis.
